name: @qu/runtime
description: Platform-specific QuStore adapters implementing @qu/core's QuAdapter contract (put/get/getAll/getChildren) for a real Node filesystem (FsAdapter), a browser's IndexedDB (IndexedDBAdapter), or a browser's sessionStorage/localStorage (SessionStorageAdapter/LocalStorageAdapter), plus IndexedDBOutboxStore (the persistent half of @qu/sync's OutboxStore contract for browsers). Deliberately no shared '.' entry point - see this file's own note below.
